title: Marina & Outdoor Recreation & Equipment Center
specs: Boat ramp and fuel dock open 24/7
Must be an authorized patron with 100% ID required
To book powerboat or sailboat, must have MCBH-MCCS boating license
For sailboats, must have pontoon license and certification from Hickam Rainbow Bay, ASA, US Sail, or equivalent
Open to Active-duty, Retirees, Dependents, & DoD Civilians only
includes: Boat ramp and fuel dock open 24/7; fuel pump is credit card only
gap: Duration of watersport rentals not stated
blurb: Offers boat slips, mooring, and boat storage with monthly rates. Provides watersport rentals including kayaks and SUPs. Requires boating license for powerboat or sailboat rentals.
extraNote: All reservations, cancellations and rescheduling must be made over the phone or in person · Transient slips scheduled in person; $16 per night with max stay 14 days · Marina at Marine Corps Base Hawaii
